titel: October 23, 2015: Open Lines - Future 30 Year Prediction Line

faehigkeiten.grund: Dynamik weder belegt noch ausgeschlossen: keine Merkmale gefunden, aber eine unveraenderte Wiederholungsprobe beweist nichts

einzeiler: Art Bell hosts open lines, discussing 30-year futures, alien megastructures, and KABC.
kurzfassung: Art Bell hosts a Friday night open lines episode where listeners call in to share their predictions for the world 30 years in the future. The conversation also covers a mysterious star with a potential alien megastructure and the search for extraterrestrial intelligence. Additionally, Bell announces that the show will be joining the KABC network starting Monday.
stichpunkte: Art Bell announces that the podcast will join the KABC radio network starting Monday.
Listeners call in to share diverse predictions for life, technology, and society 30 years into the future.
Bell discusses the recent pointing of radio dishes at star KIC 8462852 to investigate a potential alien megastructure.
Callers and Bell debate whether discovering an advanced alien civilization with no concept of religion would threaten human faith.
Bell discusses potential titles for the upcoming Halloween show, heavily leaning toward 'Dead Air'.
Various callers share personal paranormal stories, including encounters with witches and unexplained events.
Bell reflects on the rapid intensification of Hurricane Patricia in Mexico, reaching winds of 235 miles per hour.

kapitel.titel: Show Announcement and KABC Network Addition
Halloween Show Title Debate and Phone Numbers

beschreibung:
Callers predict what the world will look like in 30 years on a special line inspired by Back to the Future Day, with visions ranging from space elevators to economic collapse.
